text:
jessica_peopleops: Heads up — we're enforcing a short blackout next Fri (bridge day) for org-wide downtime. If you need an exception for caregiving, religious observance, or an urgent medical reason, please flag it here and file an exception request in the HR portal.

tom_engineering: @jessica_peopleops quick question — one of our ICs needs that Fri because their kid's school is closed. Is caregiving an approved reason for an exception?

jessica_peopleops: Yes — caregiving counts. Manager sign-off + an exception request in the portal is required. We try to approve same-day if documentation is straightforward. :thumbsup:

tom_engineering: Do we force them to use carryover before current-year accruals? They were hired in Aug so accruals are prorated.

jessica_peopleops: Good Q — we use current-year balance first. Carryover is only for end-of-year balancing and can't be consumed mid-year except in rare HR-directed adjustments.

elli_manager: Also, payroll/policy question: if a manager approves an exception after Dec 31 (for a Dec event), does carryover still apply?

jessica_peopleops: If it's around year boundary, payroll cutoff matters. Carryover calculations run Jan 2 payroll; approvals after cutoff may need manual payroll adjustments. If you anticipate post-cutoff approvals, escalate to people-ops with the `payroll` tag so we can coordinate.

people-bot: Request logged — PTO Exception #4521 created by @tom_engineering for @sara_eng. Status: pending manager approval. (view: https://hr.redwood/requests/4521)

sara_eng: Filing now, thanks. Will attach a short note about the school closure.

jessica_peopleops: Once submitted, ping me and I’ll expedite the review. If manager approval is delayed, we can provision an unpaid day as a backup so the person isn't blocked.

eli_hr: Reminder for managers: always record time-off in ADP and our portal so headcount and billing stay accurate. If you need an exception template, copy/paste this in the portal reason: `Caregiving — school closure; attaching note`

tom_engineering: Great, thanks everyone — will submit and ping @jessica_peopleops. :pray:
